page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 16 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 16 vCPUs. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 47,244 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No graphics processing units are included in this hardware profile.

The reliance on HDD storage instead of solid-state drives represents a clear tradeoff, prioritizing high storage capacity and sequential throughput over random IOPS performance. This makes the instance highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring vast storage volumes without the need for low-latency SSD access. Appropriate workloads include big data analytics, MapReduce jobs, large-scale log processing, data warehousing, and cold storage applications.
